CodeMirror 6 vendored browser bundle

Source version: 1.0.1
Source commit: 168ec1705e8f522a855c49129147494a9490b65a
Source file: dist/all.min.js

Vendoring policy: copied unchanged and embedded into the Go binary; no CDN or runtime package install.
